$comment: Mission 1.81. Narrow ted-eu:CPV-division:92 into finer-grain procurement subjects from held data, re-run the preparation, and re-select. Authoritative where paired with the generated Markdown; the gate recomputes every census, cohort, preparation and re-selection fact from the notice audit, the derivation run and re-run records, the v3 preparation, the reconciliation record and the reviewed scope rules.

measured_from.database: live, read for the audit and the derivation; the derivation wrote canonical rows as recorded below

outcome_fit: the closest of the six named outcomes, and it fits imperfectly, which the record says: the group-grain cohorts are truthful, formable and scorable, and no group is selectable at its grain because the held data cannot decide its actionability. Descending is possible and was dry-run at grains 4 and 5; it does not by itself supply the missing input, which is the vocabulary's label. So the one further grain-level mission this outcome licenses must carry that label as a semantic input, and a blind descent is refused here.

cpv_token.CPV_HELD_TOKEN_FORMAT: eight decimal digits, no check digit, no separator; scheme 'CPV'; label null on every held entry
cpv_token.depth_rule: the depth of a code is the number of leading digits before its trailing zeros; 92000000 is depth 2, 92500000 depth 3, 92521000 depth 5
cpv_token.naming_basis: the Common Procurement Vocabulary's own published structure names its levels by successive digits: division (2), group (3), class (4), category (5). This repository had named only the division before this mission (CPV_DIVISION_LENGTH); the level names are the vocabulary's, adopted in CPV_LEVELS with that basis stated, and no held token carries a level name. Mission 1.80's prose used 'class' for five-digit prefixes, which the vocabulary calls categories; corrected here.
cpv_token.repository_term_before: division only (procurement-value-contrast CPV_DIVISION_LENGTH = 2; grouping scheme CPV-division)
cpv_token.repository_term_after: CPV_LEVELS = {2: division, 3: group, 4: class, 5: category}; grouping scheme CPV-<level>
cpv_token.CPV_PARENT_RULE: the parent division of any code or prefix is its first two digits; a group code carries its division
cpv_token.why_stable: the prefix is the code's own leading digits; no lookup, no label, no mapping; the same held code yields the same prefix on every run

census.why_unavailable: every held classification entry carries exactly the keys code, scheme and label, the label is null on all 608 entries, and no entry, no notice field and no raw payload marks a code as main or additional; the status is therefore not established by the held representation and is never inferred from code order
census.note_on_mission_1_80_counts: Mission 1.80 counted 177 held notices as any notice carrying a division-92 code; that census stands. Its 'class' distribution used five-digit prefixes, which are the vocabulary's CATEGORY level, and its labels were recalled rather than held: no held record carries a CPV label at any level. Of the 177, 88 carry a code from another division as well and join no procurement cohort at any grain under the extractor's own rule, so the division-92 packet's ten rows were derived from the 89 single-division notices, not from 177.

C1_PRIMARY_CPV_ONLY.why: primary/additional status is UNAVAILABLE in the held representation; choosing codes[0] would make membership depend on the order the source happened to publish

C2_ANY_EXPLICIT_CPV_MEMBERSHIP.why: a notice carrying two groups would enter two contrasts with one value, and the existing cohort semantics (one subject per cohort, refused across divisions since 1.0.0) do not admit it

C3_MULTI_MEMBERSHIP_WITH_PROVENANCE.why: truthful in principle and not the smallest rule: it needs a witness that names which of its codes it witnesses under, which no persisted fact carries, and it would put the same published amount into two spreads; a mission that narrows a subject does not also change what a witness is

C4_REFUSE_AMBIGUOUS_NOTICE.why: the extractor's own rule since 1.0.0 for divisions, applied one level down: a notice whose codes name more than one subject at the grain, or none deep enough, joins no cohort. Every membership is decided by codes before any amount is read

membership.rule: at grain L a notice joins the cohort of the one L-digit prefix shared by every code it carries that is at least L digits deep; a code shallower than L must be an ancestor of that prefix; every code must share the division; otherwise the notice joins no cohort at grain L
membership.exclusive_assignment_basis: a notice enters at most one cohort because the rule refuses every notice that could enter two; nothing was assigned to a first or largest cohort

corrections_to_mission_1_80: Mission 1.80's held_class_distribution labels (motion picture, sports facility, museum, news agency, artistic, sound technician) were recalled from the CPV vocabulary and were not held: no held TED record carries a CPV label. The codes were held and stand.
Mission 1.80's 'classes' were five-digit prefixes, which the vocabulary names categories; classes are four-digit prefixes.
Mission 1.80's 177 is the any-code census; the division-92 packet's rows come from the 89 single-division notices, because the extractor refuses a notice across divisions at every grain.
cohort_completeness_rule: a cohort is every held notice of one acquisition window that the extractor's key gathers at the grain; membership is decided by codes, notice class, currency and amount scope before any value is read; a value-missing notice stays in the subject's membership and contributes no amount; nothing was selected after inspecting values

subject_key_contract.parent_child_explicit: the division is the prefix's first two digits and stays in the proposition facts and the sentence

labels_are_not_product_ideas: a CPV group is a filing rule; the held records carry no label, and even a label would describe procurement classification, not a customer pain, a SaaS market, a product, a startup idea or a willingness-to-pay statement

A_REUSE_EXISTING_DIVISION_EVIDENCE.why: every division-92 Signal spans at least two groups, so its magnitude is a spread ACROSS groups and no child subject can truthfully carry it

B_FILTER_EXISTING_EVIDENCE.why: a division Evidence row cites one Signal over one cohort; filtering rows reassigns whole spreads, and no row is about one group

C_RE_DERIVE_FROM_HELD_NORMALIZED_RECORDS.why: the existing extractor, with the CPV grain as a required parameter, over the same held Mission 1.40 records and the same two acquisition windows

D_ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_REQUIRED.why: a generic grain parameterisation of an established procedure, one scope field, one conditional identity field on the existing convergence contract; no new signal type, claim kind or table

derivation.minimum_basis: MINIMUM_COHORT_MEMBERS in the extractor: a contrast needs two amounts; no threshold was added
derivation.division_signals_reinterpreted_to_existi: REUSED, 0 new rows, 0 new revisions: the 1.5.0 statement of a division Signal is byte-identical to the 1.4.1 statement

currency_semantics.rule: currency is a cohort key dimension since procurement-value-contrast@1.1.0 (Mission 1.41); two currencies are two cohorts, and a single-member currency cohort is refused for insufficient input rather than merged

notice_type_semantics.rule: notice class is a cohort key dimension since procurement-value-contrast@1.0.0: a call for competition and a report of an outcome are different procurement stages, and the extractor's own docstring says so

reliability.resolution_path: LINEAGE_LATE_RESOLUTION (sros_evidence_reliability.lineage), the current machinery, over the v3 preparation
reliability.why_the_existing_scopes_apply: a reliability scope is measurement by purpose: source, resource, record kind, claim type and proposition kind. It carries no classification division (Missions 1.40 and 1.42 recorded that it binds divisions 90 and 92 alike) and it carries no classification level: the group-grain rows are the same measurement (BT-161 stated total values on the same resource and record kind) restated under the same two proposition kinds, with the level as a fact inside the proposition rather than a new kind of proposition. The reviewed limitations (options and renewals inside BT-161, unverified by TED; correction and supersession unestablished) are true of a group cohort exactly as of a division one.
reliability.what_a_reviewer_could_still_decide: that a finer classification level is a different purpose and deserves its own scope; nothing here forecloses that, and no value was invented to avoid it

division_92_packet.why_the_id_moved: a packet id hashes the procedure versions with the evidence ids, and the grouping procedure moved 1.2.0 to 1.3.0; the rows are the same ten

preparation.parent_and_child_are_not_duplicates: the division packet's ten rows cite five division Signals whose cohorts span several groups; the group packets' rows cite thirteen group Signals over subsets of the same notices. Different cohorts, different propositions, coexisting

information_gain_test.question: does one more hierarchy level change what a subject at that level can support?
information_gain_test.finding: descending is possible from held data at grains 4 and 5 and produces smaller cohorts of the same three dimensions; it changes nothing about whether a subject at that grain names one market, one service or one buyer need, because the held records carry codes and no labels at any level and the code structure splits at every level until the leaf. The structural too-broad test Mission 1.80 applied to the division is necessary and is not sufficient: applied blindly it descends to eight-digit codes and singleton cohorts. The next grain-level step is warranted only with the vocabulary's own labels for the held groups and classes as a semantic input, which is a documentation read and not an acquisition, and which this mission was not permitted to perform.

reselection.$comment: Mission 1.81 §21. The Mission 1.80 selection procedure re-run over the v3 preparation, in the same shape and under the same gates, with one ordinal rule refined: a CATEGORY one level below the scheme's coarsest reads MEDIUM semantic specificity rather than LOW, because it is narrower than its parent and still not a product.
reselection.selection_basis: no candidate passes every load-bearing gate: the four group packets are formable, scorable at reviewed reliabilities and narrower than the division, and each is a category whose held cohort still spans several classes and whose label is not held, so actionable grain cannot be established from held data; every other candidate is vetoed as in Mission 1.80
reselection.best_narrow_held_packet_basis: the group packet with the most rows (8) and the most derived cohorts (4); a count of cohorts and rows, never of value
reselection.why_they_differ: the richest packet is still the division; the group packets carry fewer rows of the same three dimensions with more specificity, and none is selectable at its grain because its actionability turns on a label the held records do not carry

candidate_universe.built_from: every packet in the v3 preparation other than the one holding the current Opportunity's cited rows
candidate_universe.identity_rule: the repository's own grouping (source-native-subject-grouping@1.3.0 over canonical-subject-registry@1.1.0 and observation-scope-rules@1.1.0); nothing merged, nothing inferred; SAME_PROBLEM_FAMILY stays PARKED

ordinal_rules.scorable_breadth: scorable rows 0 LOW, 1 to 9 MEDIUM, >= 10 HIGH
ordinal_rules.counting_dimension_diversity: counting dimensions 0 or 1 LOW, 2 MEDIUM, >= 3 HIGH
ordinal_rules.independence: UNKNOWN on every row with 0 groups is UNKNOWN; never ESTABLISHED without a group
ordinal_rules.semantic_specificity: PRODUCT and GEOGRAPHY subjects HIGH; a CATEGORY one level below the scheme's coarsest level MEDIUM; the coarsest CATEGORY, TOPIC and UNDETERMINED LOW
ordinal_rules.commercial_information: NONE without a commercial counting dimension; LOW with one on fewer than 3 scorable rows; MEDIUM with one on 3 or more scorable rows; HIGH is reserved for WILLINGNESS_TO_PAY, which no held row carries
ordinal_rules.problem_information: NONE without PROBLEM_OR_NEED, SOLUTION_GAP or SOLUTION_DISSATISFACTION
ordinal_rules.governance_distance_to_synthesis: NONE when every source in the packet is egress eligible; LOW when one open question blocks it; HIGH when a review was refused
ordinal_rules.new_acquisition_required: NO when the packet is formable from held data
